summary: Official Morbi district English and Gujarati land-record pages evidence the local/district custodian and Gujarat e-Dhara/AnyRoR procedures, but no safe anonymous parcel ID plus geometry response was verified.
queryOutcomes: English and Gujarati first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record. Both identified the official Morbi district land-record page; the English search also identified the official DILRMP Morbi status route and national NAKSHA page.
requestOutcomes: Official Morbi English and Gujarati pages returned HTTP 200. AnyRoR timed out after 20 seconds; e-Milkat timed out after 12 seconds. NAKSHA returned HTTP 200 but no Morbi parcel response. DILRMP status URL was not fetched because local TLS verification failed; verification was not disabled.
scopeLimits: No citywide open parcel coverage verified
No geometry or native ID retained
Local/district custodian is distinguished from state and national programme pages
No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe property fields, or TLS-disable exception used
uncertainty: Official procedures may expose records through interactive, session-bound or CAPTCHA-protected workflows, and programme-status pages do not establish a current public vector service. Timeout and TLS outcomes are route-specific and do not prove absence.

runtimeQualification.reason: No independently qualified real adapter or verified open parcel geometry/native-ID response.
